messages:
Theo Park: hey folks :wave: i'm theo, starting today on infra (he/him). based in seattle, hybrid. i bring my beagle to the office sometimes  and i have strong opinions about salad dressings. excited to meet y'all!
Mara Lin: welcome theo!! :tada: beagle sightings are mandatory. whats the dog's name? also salad debate: vinaigrette or ranch?
Theo Park: @Mara his name's gizmo. 80% vinaigrette, 20% chaos (ranch emergency only).
Devon Reyes: hi theo, welcome! we usually do a quick "who's bringing lunch" thread around 11:30. also FYI dog-friendly desk area is by the west window.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Theo! Please complete badge pickup and equipment request: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>. New hire lunch sign-up: <https://calendar/company-lunch|this Friday noon>. Reply "help" for assistance.
MemeBot: <https://gifs.example/gizmo-welcome.gif> :dog:
Mara Lin: OMG that gif :rofl: please bring gizmo so we can compare nose boop techniques.
Theo Park: i'll bring him friday if that's cool  and maybe some homemade dressing for a blind taste test.
Devon Reyes: count me in for judging. also quick logistics: desk swap happens next week if you want a permanent window seat, ping facilities.
Theo Park: thanks everyone! quick Q: where's the best place to stash snacks that won't mysteriously disappear?
Mara Lin: label and lock in the top shelf of the west pantry. also post a pic and it's safe. :grin:
Theo Park: noted. thanks y'all, see you Friday :coffee:
